content.value_statement: React Native tests often fail when native modules, stores, and async flows are not mocked consistently. This skill provides practical Jest and React Native Testing Library patterns.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to reset Zustand stores between tests with full-state replacement.
Demonstrates async store testing with act and waitFor.
Provides Jest mock patterns for Expo Router, SecureStore, Constants, and Haptics.
Explains React Query test wrappers and retry-free query clients.
Covers component, hook, navigation, API mock, and snapshot testing patterns.
Lists common React Native test failures and direct fixes.
limitations: It is a reference guide and does not create test files automatically.
Examples assume Jest and React Native Testing Library are already configured.
Project-specific imports, aliases, and mocks may need adjustment.
It does not replace integration testing on real devices.

use_cases.title: Stabilize Store Tests
use_cases.description: Reset Zustand state and verify async actions without cross-test leakage.

use_cases.title: Mock Expo Modules
use_cases.description: Create or review Jest mocks for routing, secure storage, constants, and haptics.

use_cases.title: Debug Test Failures
use_cases.description: Resolve act warnings, module mapping errors, async timeouts, and brittle snapshots.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Component Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to test a React Native component with React Native Testing Library. Include event handling and async assertions.

prompt_templates.title: Test a Zustand Store
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me write Jest tests for a Zustand store. Reset state before each test and verify async actions with act and waitFor.

prompt_templates.title: Review Flaky Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React Native test suite for flaky async behavior, missing Expo mocks, and brittle snapshots. Suggest focused changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Feature Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a testing strategy for a React Native feature that uses Expo Router, React Query, Zustand, and generated API hooks. Include mocks and assertions.

output_examples.input: User asks how to test a Zustand action that updates answers after an async call.
output: Reset the store before each test with full-state replacement.
Wrap the async action in act.
Read fresh state before asserting the final answer value.

output_examples.input: User asks why a React Native test shows an act warning.
output_examples.output: The response explains that an async update completed after the assertion. It recommends waiting for the final UI state.

output_examples.input: User asks how to mock Expo modules in Jest.
output_examples.output: The response identifies required mocks for router, secure storage, constants, and haptics, then checks global Jest setup first.

best_practices: Reset shared store state before every test.
Wait for async UI or store updates before asserting.
Prefer behavior assertions over broad snapshots.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on state left by previous tests.
Do not snapshot dynamic lists or frequently changing screens.
Do not duplicate mocks without checking global Jest setup.

faq.question: Which test tools does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Jest and React Native Testing Library patterns for React Native projects.

faq.question: Can it help with Expo mocks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes mock examples for Expo Router, SecureStore, Constants, and Haptics.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents testing patterns and common npm test commands.

faq.question: Can it help with Zustand stores?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains store resets, fresh state reads, and async action testing.

faq.question: Does it cover React Query?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows a test QueryClient wrapper with retry disabled.

faq.question: When should snapshots be avoided?
faq.answer: Avoid snapshots for dynamic content, frequently changing screens, and large component trees.
